SASBDB entry SASDAC2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDAC2/)

Hen egg-white lysozyme (14.3 kDa), 8.09 mg/ml in 40 mM sodium acetate pH 3.8, 10 C; EMBL X33,
DORIS III; project "Standard proteins". No publication is listed by SASBDB.
Files, all from SASBDB (https://www.sasbdb.org/rest-api/entry/summary/SASDAC2/):
  experimental_data/SASDAC2.dat    media/intensities_files/SASDAC2.dat (q in nm^-1)
  SASDAC2_fit1.fit                 media/fitting_files/SASDAC2_fit1.fit (CRYSOL, q in A^-1)
  SASDAC2_fit1_model1.pdb          media/pdb_file/SASDAC2_fit1_model1.pdb (atomic; the header is
                                   PDB 1LYZ, SASBDB gives no pdb link; no hydrogens)
SASDAC2 has two fits: fit1 is CRYSOL (chi2 1.452; used) and fit2 is DAMMIF (chi2 2.873; not used).
The .fit header says "Chi:1.205" = sqrt(1.452): the header is a chi, the REST value the chi2;
the script uses 1.452.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDAC2/ states the conditions it takes from the entry;
the paper was not consulted (there is none).
